text: Barriers to entry for small firms are becoming an increasing problem in the private fund industry under the evolving post-Dodd-Frank legal environment, with references to such barriers rising from 24 percent of respondents in 2012 to 33 percent in 2015.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, The Post Dodd-Frank Act Evolution of the Private Fund Industry Comparative Evidence from 2012 and 2 (2016). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2739479

isBasedOn.name: The Post Dodd-Frank Act Evolution of the Private Fund Industry Comparative Evidence from 2012 and 2

abstract: The 2015 survey responses suggest that barriers to entry for small firms are becoming increasingly a problem for the private fund industry in the continuously evolving post-Dodd-Frank-Act legal environment.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: 2012 and 2015 survey responses about the next five years
